name: The Lost Brother
about: A stranger at a great lord's table says he's the King's younger brother, who drowned twenty years ago. He knows things only the brother could know. You can test him, welcome him or hang him, and true or false, someone will use him.
title: The Lost Brother

new.name: {first} the Drowned
new.memory: I remember the river, and the cold, and a fisherman's wife who called me by another name for twenty years.

goal.text: Be known again as the King's brother

beats.speaker: stranger
beats.text: At {hall}, a man in a fisherman's coat stands up at {sponsor}'s table and says he's the King's brother, the one swept off the ferry at Kingsmere twenty years ago. He has the old King's chin, and a scar on his palm from a boyhood dare.

court.text: {sponsor} of {sponsor.house}: "He knows the name of your first pony, Your Grace, and the words carved under the nursery window. I thought you'd want to see him yourself."

options.label: Bring him to court and hear him out
options.hint: the whole court watches how you take it
options.result: {stranger} kneels in the King's hall. Everyone in the room looks from his face to the King's, and back.

options.label: Arrest him as a fake
options.hint: {sponsor.houseName} −20 · people wonder what you're afraid of
options.result: The King's guards drag {stranger} from {sponsor}'s table in chains. In the taverns they ask why a real King would be afraid of a fisherman.

options.label: Ignore him
options.hint: costs nothing now · the story spreads anyway
options.result: The King says nothing. {stranger} tells his story in every hall {sponsor} takes him to.

beats.speaker: elder
beats.text: {elder} served the old King's household when both princes were boys. {elder} questions {stranger} for three days. He answers most of it, and some of it he answers too well.

court.text: {elder} of {elder.house}: "He knows what a prince would know, Your Grace. He also knows what a clever servant could have overheard. There's a nurse still alive in the hills who bathed you both. She'd know."

options.label: Send for the old nurse (100 gold)
options.hint: you learn the truth, whatever it is
options.result: Riders go into the hills for an old woman who hasn't seen a court in twenty years.

options.label: Welcome him as your brother
options.hint: {sponsor.houseName} +20 · a brother at court, and whoever's behind him
options.result: The King embraces {stranger} in front of the court. {sponsor} cries the loudest.

options.label: Pay him to go away
options.result: {stranger} takes the purse and bows, then goes no further than {hall}.

beats.speaker: elder
beats.text: The nurse looks at {stranger} for a long time, then laughs. He's a mummer's son from the river towns. He once played the drowned prince in a pageant and never stopped.

court.text: {elder}: "He's a fake, Your Grace, and {sponsor} fed him, dressed him and paraded him through every hall in the realm. Was {sponsor.he} fooled, or did {sponsor.he} set the whole thing up?"

options.label: Hang the mummer and fine {sponsor}
options.hint: {sponsor.houseName} −20 · the story ends on a rope

die.how: They hanged me at Kingsmere for playing a prince too well.

options.result: {stranger} hangs at Kingsmere's gate in his fisherman's coat. {sponsor} pays the fine without a word.

options.label: Pardon him and keep him as the court fool
options.result: Now {stranger} plays the drowned prince every feast day to amuse the King. The court laughs, but {sponsor} doesn't.

beats.speaker: elder
beats.text: The nurse drops to her knees and kisses {stranger}'s scarred hand. The drowned prince is alive, so now the realm has two sons of the old King.

court.text: {elder}, quietly: "He is your brother, Your Grace. The law says nothing about a prince who comes back from the dead, so you'll have to decide."

options.label: Give your brother a council seat for his oath (300 gold)
options.hint: {sponsor.houseName} +15 · your brother is sworn to you and kept close
options.result: {stranger} swears loyalty to his brother on the old King's sword and takes a seat at the council table, away from {sponsor}.

options.label: Exile him across the sea with an income
options.result: The King's own brother boards a ship at the river mouth. {sponsor} rides beside the carriage all the way to the dock.

beats.speaker: sponsor
beats.text: {stranger} sits in the King's cells and says nothing at all. Outside, {sponsor}'s men chalk the drowned prince's sign on doors all over Kingsmere.

court.text: {sponsor}: "You've got a man in your cells whose only crime is having your brother's face, Your Grace. People are asking what else he knows."

options.label: Try him in front of the lords (150 gold)
options.hint: {sponsor.houseName} −5 · the truth comes out either way
options.result: Everyone will see the King's justice. {stranger} stands before the lords in the great hall.

options.label: Let him die quietly in his cell

die.how: They strangled me in the dark under Kingsmere and never asked my name.

options.result: {stranger} is found dead in his cell. The guards say it was a fever. The realm says it was his brother.

beats.speaker: stranger
beats.text: {stranger} rides to the hunt with the King and sits at his left hand at feasts. {sponsor} visits him often, and they talk with their heads close together.

beats.speaker: sponsor
beats.text: At {hall}, {sponsor} raises the drowned prince's banner, the old King's arms with a blue wave across them. Lords who never loved the crown send men to stand under it.

court.text: {elder}: "They're calling him the true King now, Your Grace, as if anyone could be truer than you. Buy {sponsor} off, or meet them on the battlefield."

options.label: Buy {sponsor}'s loyalty back (400 gold)
options.result: {sponsor} takes the King's gold and the wave banner comes down. {stranger} wakes up alone at {hall}.

options.label: Let them come
options.result: The King sends no gold, just a herald with a date and a battlefield.

beats.speaker: stranger
beats.text: The drowned prince's army marches on Kingsmere under the blue wave. {sponsor} leads it, with {stranger} beside {sponsor.him} wearing a crown of river reeds.

beats.speaker: stranger
beats.text: Two sons of the old King ride through Kingsmere together at the midsummer fair. {stranger} sends {sponsor} home with thanks, and the realm stops worrying about who wears the crown.

beats.speaker: elder
beats.text: The drowned prince's story ends the way it started, quietly, by the river. Ten years on, nobody under thirty believes it ever happened.
